_comment: A grip grab holds the frontage until the cursor really moves: a lone, tightly drawn-up Spearmen block (72 men, 5 files at a 0.45 m = 9 wu file pitch, drill mode, no opponent) stands centred at (700, 500) facing south. It is clicked to select it, and its east grip sits at x = 732.5: the 18 wu half-width, plus a 4.5 wu body radius and the 10 wu handle gap. That grip is first grabbed and nudged 1.5 wu outward, then released -- the frontage stays 5 files (before the fix, measuring straight to the cursor put the grab 14.5 wu, more than one and a half pitches, past the flank slot, so that nudge widened the block to 7 files). It is then grabbed again and dragged about four pitches east, and the block widens to 9 files from its fixed west edge. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
